content: GitHub spec-kit SDD layout: specs/[branch-name]/ holds spec.md (user stories, acceptance criteria, WHAT/WHY, [NEEDS CLARIFICATION] markers, completeness checklist), plan.md (tech decisions+rationale, data models, phase gates, complexity tracking, file order), data-model.md, research.md (tech context gathering), quickstart.md (validation scenarios), tasks.md (executable tasks, [P] parallel markers, deps), contracts/ (API specs). memory/constitution.md holds immutable ground-rules/articles. .specify/ holds memory + scripts + templates; .github/ holds prompts. Workflow: Spec -> Plan -> Tasks -> Implement. Provenance via git branch names + checklist gates + dated amendment process. Principle: specs as source of truth, code as regenerated output.
